context: Revalidate the current seven-prompt server inventory and landing catalog first. Reuse the existing public MCP client adapters and transport fixtures. Exercise prompts/list and prompts/get through a real stdio subprocess and the stateless HTTP ASGI route, compare names, ordering, roles, and rendered text against the registered prompt contract, and assert no MCP session affinity is required. Wire the coverage into the MCP integration gate and document any intentional catalog-only differences.
description: Successor of mcp-live-prompt-integration-coverage-v2, whose first promoted draft failed todo lint because its expected text did not declare an unfixed-tree failure. Promoted from open deferral #462 on prompts-landing-phase5-mcp-parity. Unit and render-smoke tests cover prompt generation, but the actual MCP server transport has not been exercised for prompts/list and prompts/get. Add live coverage for the supported stdio and sessionless Streamable HTTP transports, including rendered content, ordering, arguments, and the generated landing catalog mapping. This is a compatibility test follow-up; do not add new MCP tools or alter prompt semantics.
